note: Held-out calibration set for the lever-8 static FP8 scales (board 657, ruling 15019): none of the 12 ship prompts and not the gate prompt. h00-h03 are the §612-era multi-prompt pool (docs/minimax-h3/perf-optimization/v21-multiprompt-compiled/prompts.json), h04-h11 are new prompts in the ship-set style.

prompts.h00-forest-spirit: integrated_multimodal_description: In a snow-cloaked twilight forest, a small luminous spirit creeps along a fallen log while a huge sleeping beast slowly opens one eye. Footsteps crunch softly on snow; the creature breathes in a low rumble; the clip ends with a soft grunt and thud. overall_soundscape: quiet, atmospheric, crunching snow over deep breathing. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h01-cat-garden: integrated_multimodal_description: A cat walking through a sunlit garden, gentle breeze rustling leaves, slow tracking shot. overall_soundscape: Leaves rustling, distant birdsong, soft paw steps on grass. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h02-woman-smile: integrated_multimodal_description: A young woman smiling at the camera, soft studio lighting, slight head tilt, cinematic close-up portrait. overall_soundscape: Quiet studio room tone, a faint hum, a soft breath. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h03-market-mediterranean: integrated_multimodal_description: A bustling outdoor street market with people walking and vendors selling fresh fruit, Mediterranean style, midday sun. overall_soundscape: Crowd murmur, vendors calling out, coins and paper bags, distant scooters. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h04-rowing-dawn: integrated_multimodal_description: A lone rower pulls a slender scull across a glassy lake at dawn, mist lifting off the water. The camera glides alongside at water level; each stroke leaves twin whirlpools and the hull hisses forward. Pale orange light, calm realistic motion. overall_soundscape: Oars dipping and dripping, the seat sliding on its rails, the rower's steady breathing, a loon calling far away. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h05-foundry-pour: integrated_multimodal_description: Inside a dim foundry, two workers in silver heat suits tilt a crucible and pour molten bronze into a sand mould. Sparks burst upward and the glow lights their visors; the camera holds a medium shot and slowly pushes in. overall_soundscape: A deep roar of the furnace, the hiss and crackle of the pour, metal tools clanking, a muffled shout. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h06-night-rain-crosswalk: integrated_multimodal_description: A rainy city crosswalk at night, seen from a high angle: umbrellas of many colours cross in both directions while neon signs reflect in the wet asphalt. A bus passes and sprays water from a puddle. overall_soundscape: Steady rain, tires on wet road, a pedestrian signal beeping, the bus's engine and a splash. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h07-kite-cliffs: integrated_multimodal_description: A child flies a red kite on a windy grass cliff above the sea; the kite dives and recovers while the child runs backwards laughing. The camera tracks from behind and tilts up to the kite against fast-moving clouds. overall_soundscape: Strong wind buffeting, the kite's fabric snapping, waves below, a child's laugh. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h08-pottery-wheel: integrated_multimodal_description: Close-up of hands shaping a tall vase on a spinning pottery wheel; wet clay rises and widens under steady fingers, slip running down the sides. Warm workshop light, shallow depth of field, continuous rotation. overall_soundscape: The wheel's motor whirring, wet clay slapping and squelching, a radio murmuring faintly in the background. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h09-horse-canyon: integrated_multimodal_description: A rider on a chestnut horse canters along a dusty canyon trail at golden hour; dust trails behind, the rider's hat brim lifts in the wind. Low side-tracking shot with red rock walls streaming past. overall_soundscape: Hoofbeats on dry ground in a canter rhythm, leather creaking, wind, a hawk's cry echoing off the rock. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h10-aquarium-tunnel: integrated_multimodal_description: A slow walk through a glass aquarium tunnel: rays and a sea turtle glide overhead, a school of silver fish turns in unison, blue light ripples over visitors' faces. Steady forward dolly. overall_soundscape: Muffled water hum, children whispering, the soft thud of footsteps on the walkway, a faint bubbling. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.h11-street-violinist: integrated_multimodal_description: A street violinist plays under a stone archway in an old town square at dusk; her bow moves quickly, a few passers-by stop and one drops a coin into the open case. Medium shot, slight handheld sway, warm lamplight. overall_soundscape: A lively violin melody, footsteps on cobblestones, a coin landing in the case, pigeons taking off. non_diegetic_music: None.
